name: MCI (Partner)
desc:
URGENT HIRING NEED- Full-Time Call Center Representative | $17-23/hr, | Phone Heavy, No Experience Required | 
Company: MCI (Marlowe Companies Inc.)
Industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) | General Customer Service
What Your Day Will Look Like:
This is MCI's general entry-level call center role, not tied to a specific industry like insurance, just straightforward inbound and outbound customer support. You're answering questions, resolving account inquiries, and guiding customers to solutions, documenting everything accurately in company systems along the way.
This is a genuinely no-experience-required position. MCI is explicit that previous customer service experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement, so this works as a real first job in the field. You'll be expected to meet productivity, quality, and attendance standards while following established call procedures, and collaborating with your team to keep customer satisfaction high.
assessment: To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED required.
 Required Experience: None required. Must be 18 or older and fluent in English.
 Preferred Experience: Previous customer service, outbound sales, or call center sales experience. CRM software experience. Upselling/cross-selling experience. Bilingual or multilingual skills.
 Required Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication
Problem-solving and active listening
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
Reliability and consistent attendance
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with zero prior customer service experience looking for a genuine entry point into the field
Participants who are strong communicators and comfortable on the phone, even without formal experience
Anyone interested in MCI's stated internal promotion opportunities
People who want daily/weekly/monthly contest incentives layered on top of base pay
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need a confirmed, guaranteed pay number before applying, since this specific posting doesn't list one
Someone who prefers a single, consistent client account rather than potentially varying programs
Anyone who dislikes a fast-paced, quota/metric-driven environment
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
Call center
Inbound and outbound calls
Problem resolution
CRM documentation
Active listening
Multitasking
Entry-level customer support
Account inquiries
Team collaboration


4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you helped someone solve a problem, even if it wasn't in a formal customer service job.
How do you stay organized and focused during a fast-paced, high-volume workday?
Describe how you handle being told "no" or dealing with a frustrated person.
What does dependability and consistent attendance mean to you?
How comfortable are you learning new software systems and phone tools quickly?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Not confirmed in this specific posting. Comparable MCI Customer Service Representative postings range widely: $13.10-17.25/hr for one Dallas-based ValorVIP listing, with broader market data showing $17-23/hr average and a range up to $28/hr depending on location and tenure. Confirm directly.
Shift: Full-time, remote work-at-home.
Benefits: PTO and paid holidays, daily/weekly/monthly contests with cash bonuses and prizes, medical/dental/vision after 60 days (MEC plans after 30 days), retirement savings where available, short-term disability, life insurance, supplemental accident/critical illness insurance, paid training, casual dress code.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in this posting.
Felony Friendly?: Yes, stated directly in MCI's general hiring language across their postings: "MCI will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements." Still requires a background/security investigation depending on the specific program assigned, so encourage honesty and confirm specifics directly, but this is one of the clearest, most explicit statements we've found in our database.
Drug Test: Confirmed as a condition of employment on other MCI postings; job offers are typically contingent on drug screening results.
Notes: This is a genuinely accessible, no-experience-required entry point with MCI's clear, stated openness to applicants with criminal histories, one of our strongest overall leads for a participant with a felony background. Pay varies significantly by location and specific program assignment, so this needs to be confirmed directly with the recruiter rather than assumed from outside averages.
Career Pathway: Call Center Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Supervisor → Trainer/Operations Management
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
